title: 2026 – 2027 StepStone Portfolio Analytics and Reporting – Client Services Intern
description: We are global private markets specialists delivering tailored investment solutions, advisory services, and impactful, data driven insights to the world's investors. Leveraging the power of our platform and our peerless intelligence across sectors, strategies, and geographies, we help identify the advantages and the answers our clients need to succeed. **The team you'll join** You'll join StepStone's Portfolio Analytics and Reporting (SPAR) team, supporting clients across multiple private markets asset classes. While Private Equity is the primary area of focus, the team also supports Infrastructure, Real Estate, and Private Debt strategies. The team delivers portfolio reporting, data management, and analytics for private markets clients and works closely with colleagues across research, client service and other relevant departments. **About the role** StepStone is seeking a highly motivated student to join the SPAR Client Services team, where Private Equity is the primary area of focus. This internship offers hands\-on exposure to private markets, performance reporting, financial data analysis, and client service operations. You'll work alongside experienced professionals and develop a foundational understanding of private equity reporting practices, portfolio analytics, and the systems used to support high\-quality client deliverables. **What you'll do** You'll support recurring reporting processes, data validation, portfolio analysis, and team projects. Through training and practical assignments, you'll strengthen your analytical, technical, and professional communication skills while gaining insight into how a global private markets firm supports its clients. **Key responsibilities** * Assist with collecting, organising, and validating financial and portfolio data used in client reporting. * Support the preparation of recurring client deliverables and internal reporting materials. * Assist with processing quarterly reports, capital account statements, and cash flow information from private market investment managers. * Help maintain accurate information in reporting databases and proprietary systems. * Conduct research and analysis on private equity funds and market trends across strategies, sectors, and geographies. * Use Microsoft Excel and reporting tools to organise, analyse, and present data. * Support the development of presentations, charts, and visualisations for internal and client\-facing materials. * Collaborate with SPAR team members and cross\-functional partners to gather information, meet deadlines, and support ad hoc projects. **What we're looking for** * Must be able to work legally in Ireland without requiring visa sponsorship now or in the future. * Currently pursuing or recently graduated with a bachelor's or master's degree in finance, economics, accounting, business, mathematics, data analytics, or a related field. * Be able to work full time in our Dublin office November 2026 \- April 2027\. * Strong interest in financial services, private markets, portfolio analytics, or performance reporting. * Proficiency in Microsoft Excel; experience with PowerPoint or data visualisation tools is helpful. * Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem\-solving skills with close attention to detail. * Effective written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to manage multiple assignments, meet deadlines, and work in a fast\-paced environment. * Intellectual curiosity, a proactive approach, and a collaborative, team\-oriented mindset. **Why join us?** At StepStone, we foster a supportive and inclusive team culture where collaboration and learning are central to what we do. Our collegial environment encourages teamwork, mentorship, and professional development. This internship is an opportunity to gain practical experience and develop critical skills that can help launch a career in private markets, portfolio analytics, or financial services. *At StepStone, we believe that our people are our most important asset and crucial to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer that strives to create an environment that empowers our employees and allows them to be heard, regardless of title or tenure. Our organizational community features multiple Employment Resource Groups as well as mentorship programs to enhance the employee experience for all.* *As an Equal Opportunity Employer, StepStone does not discriminate on the basis of race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship status, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by law.* *Candidates must be at least 18 years old to apply.* Developing People at StepStone

title: AML Administrator
description: **AML Administrator – Fixed Term Contract** **Location: Dublin** **Department: Anti\-Money Laundering (AML)** **Grade: Fund Administrator (SFA)** **Reporting to: Assistant Vice President (AVP)** **Company** SMT Fund Services (Ireland) Limited is one of the companies that form SuMi TRUST Global Asset Services and is wholly owned by Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank, Limited, one of the largest financial services groups in Japan. SMT Fund Services (Ireland) Limited provides fund administration services to a wide variety of investment products covering all alternative and regulated products. Our service covers all the constituent parts required to independently produce a fund’s dealing or indicative net asset value (NAV) on a monthly, weekly or daily basis. **Department** The AML team manage and develop SMT's AML risk framework across the fund services / depositary business. The team provide advice and deliver AML MI reporting to a variety of areas and stakeholders and their remit covers the shaping and streamlining of SMT's non\-compliant reporting processes, while using and developing our risk based approach. The team has an in\-depth knowledge of AML Legislation, Core and Sectoral Guideline Notes as well as a demonstrable understanding of the AML requirements associated with various legal entities, fund jurisdictions and PEP's. The Team spans three companies, SMT Trustees (Ireland) Limited, SMT Fund Services (Ireland) Limited and GAS Cayman Limited, with a common goal to mitigate the risk of regulatory sanctions, material financial loss and reputational damage. **Role Overview** We are looking for a knowledgeable and experienced Administrator to join our team. The ideal candidate will have 2 years experience with AML. Your experience should include an understanding of Investment Fund and AML legislation and a demonstrable understanding of the regulatory requirements associated with fund administrators. This role will be based in Dublin. This role spans three companies, SMT Trustees (Ireland) Limited and SMT Fund Services (Ireland) Limited and GAS (Cayman) Limited and your key objective is to make sure we, our clients and their investors meet the requirements of the Criminal Justice (Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing) Act 2010, the Criminal Justice Act 2013 and the Proceeds of Crime Law in the Cayman Islands. You should have the ability to report to an experienced level, demonstrate good attention to detail, and have the ability to effectively manage competing internal deadlines. You will have the opportunity to develop strong working relationships with teams in Transition, Shareholder Services, Depositary and Corporate Governance. **Core Responsibilities** * Re\-papering Simplified and Low risk investors * Assisting in Risk Assessing all new and existing investors when required * Preparing investor and client files for sign off (Clearance) when required * Liaising with investors and clients, through telephone/written communication, until all requested AML documentation has been obtained; * Maintaining a record of complete and incomplete AML investors and ensuring action is taken to receive all outstanding documentation. * Any other ad\-hoc duties, as requested **Essential Key Requirements** * Ability to establish priorities, work independently, and proceed with objectives without supervision. * We're looking for someone who can complete their work in a timely and accurate manner and has a structured and determined approach to work. * The candidate will need to have a willingness to take ownership of problems and an ability to communicate with clients and colleagues at all levels, while maintaining a high level of professionalism. * The candidate will also need to adopt a proactive and common sense approach to problems and escalate where necessary. * You will be interested in developing your career in Compliance and AML. * Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office applications relating to designated areas of responsibility **Competencies** * Problem Solving * Prioritising * Decision Making * Team Player * Communication

title: Accountancy/Finance Graduate Development Programme 2027

We also believe in acting with integrity and transparency, protecting the world around us, and creating an inclusive and flexible culture that protects and empowers people. Across our diverse range of businesses, we use our capability and expertise to develop smart and sustainable energy solutions to tackle climate change, one of the biggest challenges facing society today. By delivering reliable, affordable, and sustainable solutions for a zero\-carbon world, we continue to transform lives and enable social and economic progress and change. This is our purpose. ESB is committed to driving society forward and delivering a net zero energy future for our customers and communities. This strong sense of purpose is reflected in our unwavering commitment to tackling some of the biggest challenges we face as a society, including climate change. **Why join us?** On our Finance Graduate Programme, you will get an opportunity to experience first\-hand how we work. You will have the opportunity to be part of our finance team on a 3\.5\-year programme and will partake in rotations across several positions to ensure a great breadth of finance experience is obtained throughout the programme. You will also be supported in obtaining your ACA qualification and becoming a qualified Chartered Accountant in association with Chartered Accountants Ireland. Our traineeship programme offers structured rotations which will give you the opportunity to gain experience across several areas including: * Core accounting foundation principles * Statutory accounting * Liaising with our external auditors * Aid in the identification and recommendation of improvements to processes/controls * Financial review, analysis and business commentary * Group Internal Audit * Set up ESB future financial systems to efficiently support proactive financial management. * Developing Finance best practices using new technologies. Central to our programme is your continuous professional development. A bespoke Graduate Training Programme will be delivered by HPC focusing on developing key skills such as effective team working, project management skills, presentation skills, commercial skills and leadership development. * Performance Orientated: On\-going one\-to\-one conversations and management reviews to ensure that you are working towards achieving your professional status and position you for a career in ESB. * Supportive Working Environment: In addition to your immediate support network of Line Manager, Middle Manager, Team Colleagues and Graduates Peers, you will also be assigned a Buddy and a Mentor. The role of a Buddy is to help you settle in during the early days of your employment, while the Mentor supports you over the entire term of the programme to guide you on your career. * Social Networking: Over the past few years our graduates have been involved in all sorts of Sports and Social activities. Anything from Tag Rugby, Cricket, Soccer and GAA to language classes, team building challenges, charity work and graduate social events. Our clubs, societies and networks are a great way to build your contacts and of course make new connections. **Why work with us?** We offer a competitive graduate salary and a comprehensive benefits package built on four pillars of Reward, Career, Community, and Well\-being: * Progressive, hybrid working model * Career development through mentoring and training * Corporate Social Responsibility opportunities * Sports and Social Clubs * Credit Union access * Pension Scheme * Employee well\-being programmes * Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion * Great team environment with our Core Values: Courageous, Caring, Trusted, and Driven **Location** As a Finance Graduate, you will be primarily based in Dublin Smart Working at ESB is designed to make ‘in\-person’ time together as purposeful as possible while also enabling the effective use of digital tools and hybrid arrangements to preserve our commitment to flexibility. The successful candidate may work flexibly within the jurisdiction where they have been employed, with attendance at the workplace for in\-person collaboration at least two days per week. All Smart Working arrangements are subject to regular review based on the operational requirements of the role, the team, and the business. **What we look for?** * You should have (or be working towards) a minimum of 2\.1 Honours Degree in Business, Accountancy \& Finance or equivalent course where your major was Accountancy * CAP 1 exemption is desirable. * Strong IT skills, knowledge of SAP, and/or experience in data analytics would be an advantage but is not essential. * You need good communication skills, excellent analytical skills, and the ability to learn quickly. * Be innovative in your approach and able to demonstrate your ability to take initiative and actively contribute to your team. Your CV should be no longer than two pages and clearly outline the following: * Title of your Degree, and Masters (if applicable) * Your results to date * Your final year subjects * The title of your final year project * Any relevant work experience * A contact telephone number (please ensure a voicemail function is activated on your phone) **Closing date: 19th October 2026**

description: **Associate / Senior Associate Transport Planner** **Locations:** Galway, Dublin, Cork, Galway, Kilkenny **Join Us in Shaping the Future of Transport Planning and Sustainable Mobility:** We are seeking a technically\-minded **Associate / Senior Associate Transport Planner** to join us in shaping the future of transport planning and appraisal across Ireland and the UK. You will support the development of junior colleagues through coaching and quality review and play a significant role throughout the lifecycle of large, multi‑year transport projects, from early options development through to planning. In addition, you will contribute to business development, thought leadership, and continuous improvement, including exploring opportunities to integrate digital and AI tools into project workflows. Over time, you will grow into a recognised subject matter expert within the business and the wider industry, influencing team strategy, shaping service offerings, and progressing within our organisation’s senior technical or leadership pathways. This includes experience applying UK Treasury Green Book and Irish TAF guidance, alongside solid knowledge of transport appraisal frameworks such as TAG and PAG and associated tools including TUBA and COBALT. You will also have experience in rail scheme development and/or multi‑modal transport modelling using platforms such as CUBE, SATURN, VISUM, VISSIM, Junctions, or LinSig. In addition, you will have experience training and developing junior staff, supporting their growth and contributing to the overall capability of the team. **Project Management** You will bring strong project management capability, demonstrated through your proven ability to act as project lead on major public‑sector transport planning projects. You will be confident managing multiple workstreams simultaneously, prioritising effectively, and providing clear reporting with minimal supervision. While not essential, a project management qualification such as APMP would be advantageous and will support your continued development in delivering complex, multi‑stakeholder programmes. **Commercial \& Financial Acumen** Understanding of commercial frameworks, budget constraints, and the need to deliver efficient project outcomes. **Client Engagement** You will demonstrate strong client engagement capability, using your excellent communication skills to build and maintain effective relationships with clients. You will have a proven track record of producing high‑quality deliverables that meet client expectations and reflect a clear understanding of their needs. Confident and credible in meetings and project discussions, you will act as a subject matter expert, providing clear guidance and contributing meaningfully to collaborative decision‑making. **Qualifications \& Experience** * Level 8 degree (or equivalent) in a relevant discipline such as: Civil Engineering, Planning, Physics, Economics, Mathematics, Geography, or another subject relevant to transport planning. * Demonstrable experience delivering major transport planning projects. * Strong technical, analytical, and report‑writing capabilities. * It would be beneficial to have: Level 9 postgraduate Master's degree in a relevant field (Transport Planning, Operational Research, Statistics, etc.). * Chartered membership of a relevant professional body. * Project management qualification (e.g., APMP). * Experience working on large‑scale public‑sector infrastructure projects. **Working Environment** The role can be based in any Ireland office, with travel expected for client meetings (typically in Dublin) and collaboration with colleagues in Cork. **Why join Tetra Tech?** Tetra Tech is a leading provider of consulting and engineering services working across the full project lifecycle worldwide. We have a wide range of expertise across our teams, providing a global support network with a personalised approach to client relationships to better understand where we can add value. We provide a collaborative environment that supports individual performance, innovation, and creativity. We support public and private sector clients on local, national, and international projects to deliver sustainable and resilient solutions. Our operations in the UK, Ireland, and the Netherlands include more than 6,000 employees who are Leading with Science® to solve our clients’ most complex problems. description: **About This Role** **Company Description** HPS Investment Partners, a part of BlackRock, is a leading global, credit\-focused alternative investment manager that seeks to provide creative capital solutions and generate attractive risk\-adjusted returns for our clients. We manage various strategies across the capital structure, including privately negotiated senior debt; privately negotiated junior capital solutions in debt, preferred and equity formats; liquid credit including syndicated leveraged loans, collateralized loan obligations and high yield bonds; asset\-based finance and real estate. The scale and breadth of our platform offers the flexibility to invest in companies large and small, through standard or customized solutions. HPS was established in 2007 as a unit of Highbridge Capital Management, LLC (“HCM”), a subsidiary of JPMorgan Asset Management (“JPMAM”). On March 31, 2016, the senior executives of HPS acquired HPS and its subsidiaries from JPMAM and HCM (the “Transaction”.\[i] Following the Transaction, JPMAM retained a passive minority investment in HPS, which was subsequently redeemed in April 2022\. In June 2018, affiliates of Dyal Capital Partners made a passive minority investment in HPS. In February 2022, an affiliate of The Guardian Life Insurance Company of America made a passive minority investment in HPS, which was subsequently increased in August 2024\. On July 1, 2025, BlackRock acquired the business and assets of HPS, with 100% of consideration paid in BlackRock equity (the “HPS/BlackRock Transaction”). The HPS/BlackRock Transaction brings together BlackRock’s corporate and asset owner relationships with HPS’s diversified origination and capital flexibility. BlackRock and HPS have formed a new private financing solutions business unit (“PFS”) led by Scott Kapnick, Scot French, and Michael Patterson, creating an integrated franchise with approximately $370 billion in client assets, including $205 billion of private credit assets.\[ii] This combined platform, which has more than 590 investment professionals and approximately 1,300 employees globally,\[iii] offers broad capabilities across senior and junior credit solutions, asset\-based finance, real estate, CLOs and GP\-LP solutions. As part of the HPS/BlackRock Transaction, Scott Kapnick, Scot French, and Michael Patterson have joined BlackRock’s Global Executive Committee, and Scott Kapnick has been appointed as an observer to the BlackRock Board. **Position Description** The Fund Reporting Associate will support the coordination, execution, and quality of financial and regulatory reporting activities for Private Credit funds. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock. **Guidance on AI use for candidates** At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision\-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided **guidance** on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self. **About BlackRock** At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive. It is a friendly and welcoming, purpose\-built unit, staffed by a specialist cancer nurse and volunteers. **Main duties and responsibilities:** The post holder must be a registered nurse with oncology knowledge and experience who is able to discuss and assess complex cancer needs as well as related practical and emotional matters with anyone who contacts the Daffodil Centre. They must have the leadership and organisational skills to manage and develop the centre and the people skills to interact with enquirers as well as with internal and external stakeholders. * Be responsible for the leadership/management of the Daffodil Centre, including promotion and continuous development of the service and for raising awareness of its availability, both within the hospital and in the local community. * Provide specialist information, education and support to anyone affected by cancer that visits or contacts the centre – this could be a person with a diagnosis, friend/relative/carer, someone concerned about symptoms or seeking cancer prevention/health promotion material or a health care professional. * Develop and maintain information resources available within the centre for service users. * Deliver Irish Cancer Society patient education programmes. * Manage and mentor the Daffodil Centre volunteers. **Delivering person centred care and education:** * Be responsive in understanding and addressing the needs of service users and complete a Needs Assessment with them, if appropriate. * Provide comprehensive cancer information, advice and support to patients, carers, the public and healthcare professionals (face\-to\-face, telephone, email and written). * Refer enquirers to other services within the Irish Cancer Society, as well as to other relevant health care professionals and/or organisations. * Deliver the Society’s patient education programmes locally in groups and online as required. * Act as a resource to the multidisciplinary teams in the hospital on information, supports and services available to those affected by cancer. * Present to various external groups on a variety of cancer topics, including cancer prevention to cancer treatments, side\-effects and follow\-up care, as well as the different services available from the Irish Cancer Society. **Leadership of the Daffodil Centre and volunteer management:** * Work with managers in both the hospital and the Irish Cancer Society to develop and manage the Daffodil Centre, ensuring that it is open as advertised, delivering an accessible and high\-quality professional service. * Implement the hospital and the Irish Cancer Society policies, procedures and guidelines. * Continually seek out ways to develop our services and supports and improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the centre. * Work with the Team Lead and Services Coordination Team to prepare regular and end of year service activity reports. * Keep informed of Irish Cancer Society campaigns and events, which may impact on centre activity e.g. an increased number of calls or emails on a specific issue. * Work with the Society’s Volunteer Team and the Team Lead to recruit, interview and train volunteers. * Manage and supervise the competence of volunteers working in the Daffodil Centre. * Provide the volunteers with ongoing support and supervision. * Report any concerns regarding volunteers to the Daffodil Centre Team Leaders. **Communication, relationship management and promotion of the Daffodil Centre and the Irish Cancer Society:** * Establish and maintain good working relationships with the multidisciplinary teams involved in the delivery of cancer care within the hospital. * Develop and maintain close links with the Services Team and all other relevant departments of the Irish Cancer Society. * Work to expand the reach and impact of the Daffodil Centre in the community within the hospital catchment area. * Work with the Daffodil Centre Team Leaders to ensure you have the appropriate promotional materials/resources for the centre and an adequate supply. * Present to various internal and external groups on the services provided by the Irish Cancer Society. * Participate and assist with the Irish Cancer Society exhibition stands at various events/conferences for both patients and health care professionals * Take part in media relations activity on behalf of the Irish Cancer Society. **Information Development:** * Maintain a comprehensive resource of high\-quality evidence based, relevant information, encompassing all aspects of cancer, care and support. * Be responsible for maintaining stock levels of patient information materials, including Irish Cancer Society materials (booklets/factsheets), which will be displayed in the Daffodil Centre as well as online links to evidenced based patient information relating to cancer. * Work with the Society’s Education and Engagement team to develop and update information materials about cancer types, cancer treatments and other patient information resources. * Contribute to the development of the Society’s patient education programmes. **Professional Development:** * Maintain a knowledge base on developments in cancer care and of resources/services for cancer patients, particularly in the hospital catchment area. * Attend and/or participate in relevant courses/workshops/conferences as appropriate to maintain own continuous professional development. * Participate in Community and Hospital Services Meetings, journal clubs and other training and education opportunities as provided by the Society and the hospital. * Participate in clinical supervision. **Governance:** * Comply with the need for service user confidentiality, including requirements of GDPR/Data Protection Act. * Assist in the maintenance and monitoring of an appropriate and acceptable environment for enquirers, reporting and taking necessary action on any hazards. * Record and report all incidents/complaints involving staff and/or service users and assist in any investigation as required in accordance with Irish Cancer Society’s and hospital policies. * Undertake and ensure that both you and the volunteers attend mandatory training and refresher training as required by the Irish Cancer Society and the hospital. * Use data gathered, as well as other sources such as monthly activity reports, to monitor the usage of the Daffodil Centre to identify areas for change/improvement. **General:** * Provide cover as and when required in other Daffodil Centres and Support Line. * Support with Irish Cancer Society events. These may be in the evenings and/or at weekends, but notice will be provided. The list of duties in this job description is not exhaustive and is intended to outline the main activities of the post holder. Duties and responsibilities may be subject to change considering the development needs of the service. While the post\-holder will be an employee of the Irish Cancer Society he/she will work in St. James Hospital and will be located there. The post holder must adhere to general conditions as outlined by the hospital in relation to Health and Safety, Infection Control, Dress Code and adhere to guidelines/requirements in relation to Risk Management, Hygiene Services and Health and Safety. (Full details will be provided upon commencement of employment.) **Who You Are:** The right candidate for this role is: * **A people person:** whether it’s supporting patients and enquirers, working with colleagues and volunteers, or engaging with clinicians you understand what makes people tick, and create effective relationships. * **A great communicator:** you can communicate effectively across multiple channels (face\-to\-face, written, digital) and adopt your style to meet the audience where they are. * **A superb leader:** you can positively lead people to meet their goals, delegate when needed and support a team in a developing service. You know the value of the people who work with you. * **Wonderfully Organised:** you can manage lots of different tasks at the same time, prioritise workload and take pride in running a high\-quality service. * **Technologically savvy:** you’re comfortable using digital and technology tools for the management and delivery of programmes and identifying new ways that technology can support your work. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees. The current contribution rate ranges from a contribution of 3%, 5% or a maximum of 8% of basic salary. * Group membership for VHI and HSF (health plans) * Bus/Rail Ticket Scheme and Cycle to Work Scheme * Death In Service Benefit (from commencement of employment) * Paid Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity, Adoptive, Force Majeure and compassionate Leave) * Learning and Development Programmes * Educational Assistance (Study and Examination Leave) * Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) * Optional Flu vaccine provided

Join Boots as a Seasonal Customer Assistant and be part of something special.** The festive season at Boots is one of the busiest and most exciting times of the year, and we're looking for enthusiastic people to help create brilliant experiences for our customers when it matters most. **About The Opportunity** As a Seasonal Customer Assistant, you'll be at the heart of the action, helping customers find the perfect gift, discover great offers and get what they need for the celebrations ahead. Find out more at **boots.jobs/ireland** *Exclusions may apply; eligible roles only. Please note that any salary estimates provided on third\-party sites are not endorsed by Boots and may not be accurate.* **A Bit About Us** At Boots, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, creating a place where everyone feels welcome, supported, and free to be themselves. We believe that when our people feel valued and included, they thrive, so we're committed to creating a brilliant Boots for our people so they can make a difference for our customers and colleagues every time. **What’s next?** If you apply, our team will be in touch to let you know the outcome of your application or to arrange next steps. If you require additional support as part of the application and interview process, we are happy to provide reasonable adjustments to help you be at your best. **We hope to hear from you soon. Be brilliant with Boots.**

description: Location: Sports Surgery Clinic Job type: Permanent (37\.5 hours per week) **Overview Of Role** The Sports Surgery Clinic Diagnostic Imaging Department is looking to recruit an enthusiastic clerical officer to join our team. **Primary Duties And Responsibilities** * Welcomes patients and their families professionally and delivers excellence in the administration of the patient episode. * To ensure the seamless administration of the patient episode from referral to scheduling/handover to clinical colleagues. * Ensures that the patient is properly identified and that all records match, and are verified as correct by the patient. * Ensures all paperwork including insurance documentation is accurate, signed and in order prior to patient leaving Radiology Reception Ensures that all payments are deducted as necessary. * Rotates between reception and call centre as required. * Schedules patients as per requests. description: Emergn is a technology and management consultancy with a mission to set our clients free. No dependency. No short\-term fix. A professional certification (e.g. ACCA, CPA, CFA) is a plus. * Some experience in commercial finance, FP\&A, or a similar analytical finance role. * Strong analytical skills and good commercial judgement. * Good communication and a collaborative, team\-oriented approach. * Curiosity and a willingness to learn the IP and tax side of the role. **What we offer:** * Work within a dynamic international team of experts. * Excellent opportunity for personal and professional development. * Flexible work model and the freedom to choose the tools that suit you best – Mac or Windows. * Ability to work with modern technologies. * Extensive catalogue of educational programs, the possibility of training and certification at the expense of the company. * Health and life insurance. * 25 days annual leave. * Medical and Dental benefits. * Birthday gift. * Travel insurance.

title: Commercial Graduate Development Programme 2027
description: Vacancy Number: 28989 Category: Graduates \- Business Job Type: Full\-time **ESB Commercial Graduate Development Programme 2027** **Why join us?** Our Commercial Graduate Development Programme will focus on developing your ability to problem solve, think critically, understand the balance between value and risk and will build your decision\-making capability. The programme also develops effective communication and influencing skills, the building blocks of effective negotiation – critical to succeeding as a commercial business leader. At ESB, the opportunities and the experience for Commercial graduates are both diverse and exciting. Can you imagine yourself developing products and services that help ESB compete and grow in a competitive market? How about sitting across the table negotiating a multi\-million\-euro contract? What about assessing the commercial viability of ESB’s next solar farm? Could you influence policy decisions that support ESB, customers and Ireland? If these are the kinds of challenges that excite you, our Commercial Graduate Development Programme will help you build the skills, confidence and experience to turn that ambition into a successful commercial career. Our bespoke Commercial Graduate Development Programme includes: * Structured Rotations: – Our programme is structured into rotations where you will gain exposure across our diverse businesses. * Learning \& Development: – Central to our programme is your continuous professional development. A bespoke Graduate Training Programme designed to develop your leadership capability. Graduates also benefit from hands\-on learning and fully supported personal development plans agreed with their manager. * Performance Orientated: – At the start of each rotation, you’ll agree clear goals with your line manager and receive regular feedback, guidance and support to help you succeed and develop your career. * Supportive Working Environment: – You will be supported by your Line Manager, Middle Manager, Team Colleagues and Graduate Peers, and assigned a Buddy to help you settle in and a Mentor to guide your career development and rotations throughout the programme. * Social Networking: – Our graduates take part in a wide range of sports, social and development activities, from Tag Rugby, Cricket, Soccer and GAA to language classes, team\-building challenges, charity work and graduate social events. Our clubs, societies and networks are a great way to build contacts and make new connections. **Why work with us?** We offer a competitive graduate salary and a comprehensive benefits package built on four pillars of Reward, Career, Community, and Well\-being: * Progressive, hybrid working model * Career development through mentoring and training * Corporate Social Responsibility opportunities * Sports and Social Clubs * Credit Union access * Pension Scheme * Employee well\-being programmes * Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion * Great team environment with our Core Values: Courageous, Caring, Trusted, and Driven **Location** As a Commercial Graduate, you will assigned placements across ESB’s offices in the Dublin area. Smart Working at ESB is designed to make ‘in\-person’ time together as purposeful as possible while also enabling the effective use of digital tools and hybrid arrangements to preserve our commitment to flexibility. The successful candidate may work flexibly within the jurisdiction where they have been employed, with attendance at the workplace for in\-person collaboration at least two days per week. All Smart Working arrangements are subject to regular review based on the operational requirements of the role, the team, and the business. **What We Look For?** * You should have (or be working towards) a minimum 2\.1 Honours degree in a discipline that demonstrates strong analytical, commercial and communication skills * Good communication skills, excellent analytical skills and the ability to learn quickly * Be innovative in your approach and able to demonstrate your ability to actively contribute to your team * A proactive, driven mindset with the motivation to learn, contribute and make an impact * Previous relevant work experience would be an advantage but is not essential Your CV should be no longer than 2 pages and clearly outline the following: * Title of your Degree, and Masters (if applicable) * Your results to date * Your final year subjects * The title of your Final Year project * Any relevant work experiences * A contact telephone number (please ensure a voicemail function is activated on your phone) **Closing Date: 19th October 2026** **Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Statement** ESB is committed to being an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all sections of society and ensure that no one is discriminated against on the grounds of race, religion or belief, ethnicity or nationality, disability, age, citizenship, marital status, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation or gender identity, or any other basis as protected by law. Applicants who anticipate requiring assistance or reasonable accommodations for any part of the application or interview process may contact, in confidence, recruitment@esb.ie. **About ESB** Join us in our mission to achieve a net\-zero electricity system by 2040\. ESB is Ireland’s leading energy utility, with activities spanning electricity generation, transmission and distribution, energy supply, energy services and international consultancy. Operating in Ireland, Northern Ireland and Great Britain, we invest over €1 billion each year to deliver a new energy future based on reliable, affordable zero\-carbon electricity.

description: *To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.* **About Futureforce University Recruiting** Our Futureforce University Recruiting program is dedicated to attracting, retaining and cultivating talent. Our interns and new graduates work on real projects that affect how our business runs, giving them the opportunity to make a tangible impact on the future of our company. With offices all over the world, our recruits have the chance to collaborate and connect with fellow employees on a global scale. We offer job shadowing, mentorship programs, talent development courses, and much more. **Job Category** Sales **Job Details** **About Salesforce** Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. **Fixed\-term contract** **Duration:** 12 months **Start Date:** February 2028 We are thrilled to invite ambitious graduate candidates who would like to build a career in **Salesforce** to apply for the **next** **cohort** of our **EMEA Graduate Rotation Program \- Sales Path** . This exciting **12\-month program** is designed to give graduates exposure to both sales and solution engineering. Having built the foundational skills for both roles and met our eligibility criteria, top graduates on this path can begin their **Salesforce Sales** careers. The promotion window opens from **month 7 onwards.** Our graduate program is a fully immersive experience, combining comprehensive learning paths with in\-role experience. You will be assigned experienced **Sales Development Buddys** who will provide hands\-on coaching, invite you to join their discovery and qualification calls, giving you the confidence to pick up the phone to reach out to your first salesforce customers. You will also be paired with experienced **Solution Engineer Buddies** during the SE Rotation who will involve you in their live deals. Throughout the programme, you will gain exposure to senior sales and solution engineering professionals during our inspiration sessions. By joining Salesforce, you will have the opportunity to lay the foundation for a **fast\-paced, successful career** . We are a proud member of the **Fortune 100 Best Places to Work** list for the past 14 years and a consistent winner of **Great Place to Work** awards. Who are we looking for? * You are a 2025 or 2026 graduate (minimum bachelor’s degree), ideally in Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, Chemistry or another science discipline. We also welcome graduates from all other academic backgrounds. * You are interested in the impact technology can have on the world and business * You are a creative problem\-solver * You are a relationship builder and possess a growth mindset * You are curious, self\-motivated, and focused on continuous learning * You thrive in a team environment * You have excellent interpersonal skills * You are goal\-oriented and comfortable in a fast\-paced environment * You are fluent in English \& Arabic is Essential What does our EMEA Graduate Program look like? **The Program Is Structured As Follows** Introduction Month During your first month, you will receive extensive onboarding enablement through a Salesforce\-style academy, where you will: * Become immersed in the culture of Salesforce and gain a deep understanding of our values * Develop an understanding of our solutions, technologies, and tools * Learn critical professional skills for your career at Salesforce * Follow a structured learning calendar with sessions and hands\-on workshops led by experts and program alumni Rotations During the Graduate Program, graduates on both the Sales and Solution Engineering Paths will follow the same curriculum and complete the same rotations. Essentially you will gain exposure to both the **Sales and Solution Engineering Roles** . The structure of each rotation is similar: you will spend **60% of your time** immersed in the role with clear tasks, targets, and stakeholder alignment, while the remaining **40%** will focus on role\-specific learning. You will be paired with experienced buddies in each path. If your first rotation (months 2 through 4\) is in **Sales** , you will then join the **Solution Engineering Rotation** from months 5 through 7, and vice versa. Over these six months, you will have built the fundamental skills for these complementary disciplines. Having gone deeper on your solution knowledge, learning how to demo and having exposure to later stages of the sales cycle during the solution engineering rotation will set you up for sucess as you promote throught the various sales roles \- SDR, BDR, AE and beyond. Throughout the rotations, there will be **self\-paced certifications and skills assessments** . You must meet all eligibility criteria before you can **panel for promotion** . Examples of what you can expect during the rotations **Sales Graduate Rotation** * Learn Salesforce’s best\-in\-class prospecting and qualification methodologies * Learn how to use social, digital, video, chat, and phone platforms to effectively engage Salesforce prospects * Collaborate with Sales Development Specialists to run campaigns and help build sales pipeline for the EMEA Sales organisation **Solution Engineering Graduate Rotation** * Learn our solutions at a deeper, more technical level * Work closely with the Solution Engineering organisation, supporting the creation of cutting\-edge customer demonstrations * Learn the art of customer discovery and how to create a compelling customer point of view What’s in it for you? * A clear and structured career path within our Sales organisation * The opportunity to work in an international team within a nurturing environment * Access to our diverse internal employee groups * A comprehensive benefits package * Relocation budget and guidance throughout your relocation process * An additional seven days of paid time off for charitable causes – learn more about our 1\-1\-1 model Map your future for the coming years With the **EMEA Graduate Program – Sales Path** , you can continue to progress: * After your Grad Program Rotations you can progress to Sales Development Representative, Business Development Representative and then Account Executive, where you will position our solutions to potential customers. In some instances, this path may vary or be subject to change. Unleash Your Potential When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. title: Frontend Developer
description: Apata is a fintech company building a new generation of flexible fraud\-prevention solutions for card issuers. Our platform authenticates more than 30 million e\-commerce transactions a month for cardholders worldwide, and is trusted by around 100 financial institutions globally. We're growing fast, and the frontend is central to how issuers and merchants experience what we do \- so this is a great time to join a small, experienced team where your work ships and matters. **What you'll work on** Our customers configure every part of the cardholder experience \- the flow each cardholder moves through at transaction time \- through the UI our team builds. The frontend isn't the transaction engine, but it's the surface that decides how those millions of transactions behave. You'll work across three frontend surfaces: * A merchant\-facing single\-page app \- React on Vite, TypeScript throughout, part of a pnpm/Turborepo monorepo, talking to a backend\-for\-frontend (BFF). * A Next.js application \- TypeScript, tRPC, and TanStack Query. * Our public marketing website \- the front door for prospective customers. The two product apps are TypeScript\-first and share tooling and patterns across the monorepo. You'll get exposure across all three, and to a range of frontend work as you grow with the team. **What you'll do** * Build and ship frontend features \- writing reliable, reusable, well\-tested code. * Take part in code reviews and technical discussions, and grow your skills with support from the senior engineers on the team. * Work with backend and platform engineers on the APIs your features rely on. * Work closely with design to turn wireframes and mock\-ups into high\-quality components. * Care about the performance, quality, and responsiveness of what you build. * Contribute to technical design discussions for the features you work on. **What we're looking for** * 4\+ years of professional frontend experience, comfortable working independently on well\-scoped features. * Solid, hands\-on experience building with React and TypeScript \- the core of both products. * A good command of modern JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. * Experience with single\-page apps, and either exposure to or genuine eagerness to learn server\-rendered / Next.js\-style applications. * Comfort with build tooling (Vite and similar) and browser debugging. * Good testing habits \- writing unit and component tests for your work. * A good understanding of how frontend work gets built and shipped. * A collaborative approach and real eagerness to grow \- you take ownership of your work, ask good questions, and level up with the team. **Nice to have** * Monorepo tooling (Turborepo, pnpm). * Experience with BFF / API layers, or with tRPC. * Domain exposure to payments, 3DS, or fintech more broadly. **What we offer** * Competitive salary and equity in a fast\-growing startup. * Health insurance and a pension plan. * Flexible paid time off.

title: Graduate Engineer – Civil Engineer
description: We are proud to take an active part in shaping Ireland’s future. To work with the government, clients and communities to plan, build and sustain infrastructure that will advance and enhance the Irish way of life. The Egis team have been active in Ireland since 1959, evolving and expanding over time into a company that offers an end\-to\-end service; planning, designing and operating smart cities, active travel systems, water and energy infrastructure, buildings and structures. In 2023 JB Barry and Partners was welcomed into Egis, bringing our award\-winning team to almost 600 members across 16 offices nationwide. Our Team includes designers, engineers, surveyors, project managers, technologists, geo\-technical and environmental teams, asset and maintenance managers and quantity surveyors all working together We work in partnership with public sector clients and private companies both at home and internationally, and we are committed to supporting the government in realising their climate, infrastructural and societal goals as part of Project Ireland 2040 Our key areas of expertise in Structural Design include: * Smart cities * Large Scale Residential and Commercial Buildings * Water \& Wastewater Our key areas of expertise in Civil include * Rail \& Urban transit * Active travel * Roads and bridges * Water \& Wastewater * Smart cities * Energy * Consulting and Operations **Job Description** As a **Graduate Engineer** , you will join our structured **Graduate Programme** , designed to accelerate your professional development and provide exposure to some of the UK’s most significant infrastructure projects, focusing on **Energy and Sustainable Projects** You will work alongside experienced engineers and project managers, gaining hands\-on experience in design, construction, and delivery phases. Rotations will allow you to explore different disciplines and understand the full lifecycle of major projects. **Key Responsibilities** **Essential** * Good understanding of core civil engineering principles, including earthworks, drainage, geotechnics, structures and infrastructure design. * Strong numerical, analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to interpret engineering drawings, survey information, specifications and technical data. * Good written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary project teams. * Competence in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word. * Ability to manage assigned tasks and work to agreed deadlines. * Willingness to undertake site visits and travel as required. **Desirable** * Internship, placement or project experience within an engineering consultancy, contractor, developer, utility or infrastructure organisation. * Exposure to renewable energy projects, particularly wind, solar, BESS or grid infrastructure. * Familiarity with AutoCAD and/or Civil 3D. * Experience with GIS software such as QGIS or ArcGIS. * Exposure to ground investigation, earthworks, drainage, road design or foundation engineering. * Awareness of Eurocodes and relevant Irish/UK engineering standards. * Understanding of construction health and safety requirements. Full driving licence **Qualifications** * Level 8 Honours Degree in Civil Engineering (minimum 2\.1\) from an accredited institution. * Level 9 postgraduate qualification in Civil, Structural, Geotechnical, Environmental or Energy Engineering would be advantageous. * Degree meeting, or capable of meeting, the academic requirements for progression toward Chartered Engineer status with Engineers Ireland or an equivalent professional institution. **Additional Information** **We are committed to our planet** In each project we design, engineer and operate we care deeply about the legacy we’re leaving behind. As part of our team, you’ll have a unique opportunity to use your skills and expertise to shape a better future for our communities in the UK, and all around the globe. Our commitment is translated in the work carried out by our Egis Foundation, which funds concrete actions to address the climate crisis and is focused on educational and social initiatives that will help in the responsible and sustainable shift towards a sustainable world. **Equality, Diversity \& Inclusion** *We are an Equal Opportunities employer, and we strive to build a workforce that truly reflects the communities we represent. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender identity, gender expression, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and any other protected characteristic. If you decide to apply for an opportunity with us, your application will be assessed based purely on your experience, the essential and desirable criteria, and your suitability for the role. We value each and every one’s contribution as this builds our culture and means that if you work with us, you will be included, listened to, and respected.*

description: **Join Our Team** **PLEASE NOTE THIS POSITION IS TO START IN SEPTEMBER 2027** Our Building Services teams at Cundall play a key role in making buildings more energy efficient, cost effective to run and, ultimately, more sustainable. To do this, we’re looking for graduates who have a desire and enthusiasm to make a difference: in our homes, offices, projects, industry and community. Working across a variety of sectors, our building services engineers are a source of world leading expertise, producing innovative and award\-winning sustainable engineering solutions throughout the lifecycle of any building project. With 29 locations globally, we offer a pro\-active and collaborative approach to skill development, professional excellence and knowledge sharing. Our Building Services teams have worked on a range of amazing projects, from data centres for large tech companies to headquarters of companies such as Deutsche Bank and Diageo. As a graduate in the team, you could play a key part in our next big project. **The Role You'll Play** As a Graduate Mechanical Engineer, you’ll join a team who specialise in the design of some of the most exciting construction projects in Ireland and worldwide. Working closely with colleagues across our multi\-disciplinary practice, you’ll provide specialist consultancy input on projects across a wide range of sectors including education, healthcare, workplace, retail and critical systems (data centres). Under the guidance of our team of experienced engineers, we’ll equip you to undertake detailed mechanical building services engineering design and analysis, define and translate clients’ needs into designs for buildings, facilities and services (ventilation, cooling and air conditioning, heating systems and more) \- all with sustainability at the forefront of the design. You’ll have the opportunity over time to assume greater levels of responsibility and autonomy as your professional skills develop and with accredited professional development programmes from CIBSE and IMechE you’ll be fully supported towards achieving chartership. **The Skills You'll Bring** * On target to achieve at least a 2:2 degree. * Desirable if accredited with or on course to achieve a BEng/MEng degree level (or equivalent) in Mechanical or Building Services Engineering. * Have a passion about innovative and sustainable mechanical engineering for the built environment. * Possessing a desire for personal and professional development, you’ll have the proven ability to work effectively as part of a team. * Digital engineering is a big focus at Cundall, so ideally, you’ll have an understanding of Parametric Modelling Techniques (Grasshopper or Dynamo), or at least one modern programming language (e.g. Python, C\#, VB). * You are organised and methodical in your approach to managing your tasks and priorities, striving to meet deadlines. * Collaborative in nature, you’ll be able to empathise with your clients’ needs and utilise excellent communication skills, both in writing and verbally, with internal and external stakeholders. You’re used to using your initiative to overcome challenges and have a positive, can\-do attitude. **What’s in it for you?** We offer a competitive starting salary which grows as you develop, as well as many training and development opportunities to make sure you keep progressing. Aside from this, those who successfully join our graduate scheme also enjoy: * A one\-off joining bonus of €1,500, payable during your first week of employment. * A €2,000 bonus on gaining chartered status with a relevant professional body. * 25 days' holiday per annum (plus statutory holidays). * A flexible benefits package which enables you to select additional benefits to suit your personal circumstances. Graduate Brochure **Job Description** Must have right to work in Ireland, we do not provide sponsorship for this role. **We know that to be the best at what we do we need a diverse workforce underpinned by an inclusive culture. Creating environments where everyone can find joy doing their best work is also great for everyone. That’s why we positively welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and identities, and encourage, support, and celebrate the diverse voices of our people.**

title: HR Officer
description: Ryanair, over our 40 year history has grown to become Europe’s largest airline group connecting more guests across more routes than any other European carrier. We are a fast\-paced, ambitious and innovative company, offering exciting career opportunities across aviation, technology, operations and support functions. Now is a fantastic time to join as we look to grow to over 800 aircraft and 300m guests within the next 8 years. Ryanair are currently recruiting for a **HR Officer** to join Europe’s Largest Airline Group. This is an excellent opportunity to join as we look to grow to over 800 aircraft and 300m guests within the next 10 years. The life of a HR Officer at Ryanair can vary quite a bit! They are the face of our HR Team and will be on hand to support our 29,000\+ aviation professionals across our growing European network. The HR Officer deals with a broad range HR issues and administration, from legal cases to drafting contracts and all the stuff in between, while travelling frequently to your assigned bases to meet with employees and answer an queries they may have. At Ryanair, you will gain vast experience very early in your career as you are entrusted and expected to act like a HR Manager for the 1000\+ employees under your remit to make daily decisions, offer advice and resolve all employee relations matters that arise. This is a perfect opportunity for a recent graduate seeking a challenge and to join a fast paced and dynamic working environment. **Duties Include** * Managing the entire HR function for up to 1000\+ employees in your assigned bases/ areas. * Monitoring employee absence and turnover to identify trends and deal with same. * Liaising, supporting and advising management at all levels across the business on all HR related matters, ranging from general queries, grievances to disciplinary investigations and legal case preparation. * Maintain the HR databases to ensure all files and the HR system is up to date and accurate. * Weekly reporting to the HR Manager on all HR issues in your area * Contract, payroll \& reference etc. administration. * Good knowledge of business and HR model to answer daily employee queries and make informed decisions. * Excellent writing skills to be able to compose important disciplinary etc. letters. * Working on ad hoc projects as and when they arise. * Legal case preparation for local litigation across Europe and for WRC \& LC. * Travelling across Europe to meet with employees on general employment matters, attend interviews and employee negotiations. * Relevant HR or business degree is essential * Ability to work in a pressurised and fast paced environment * Strong organisational skills * Strong interpersonal skills * The ability to work on own initiative * Excellent verbal and written communication skills * The ability to work under tight deadlines effectively and efficiently * PC Skills (Word, Excel, Power point etc) * Competitive salary * Discounted and unlimited travel to over 250 destinations * Defined Contribution Pension Scheme * Death in Service Benefit – Up to 2 times of annual basic salary * 20 Days Annual Leave – Increasing to 22 days after 12 months and 25 days after 3 years of continuous service. * Option for up to 5 additional unpaid leave days per year * Cycle 2 Work Scheme * Unrivalled career progression

Health and Safety requirements. * Assist in keeping the ward areas and day room tidy. * Carry out errands as requested by Clinical Nurse Managers or Deputies e.g. collect faxes/charts, patient errands within the clinic, pharmacy, stores, laboratory and errands to other wards. * Report broken items in need of repair to the Clinical Nurse Manager. * Wash all patients’ basins daily, also drip stands, fans, feeding pumps and other equipment as required. * Report to nursing staff any complaints of pain, distress or needs expressed by patients. * Assist other support staff with storage of CSSD and stores. * Assist the transport team transport patients to and from Theatre. * Work as a Covid\-19 swabbing HCA in the Test Centre. **Qualifications \& Experience** * Possess a good standard of and efficient service. * Be of good character. Salary: €36,069\.00 \- €42,177\.00 per annum based on a 39 hour working week. **Equal Opportunity Statement And Benefits** **UPMC is an equal opportunity employer. title: ICT Infrastructure Analyst
description: Job Purpose To provide effective, secure ICT support services to our Ireland users and business functions. The ICT Analyst delivers frontline, Level 1 and Level 2 technical support; administers on\-premises and cloud services; supports Microsoft 365, Azure and Microsoft Entra ID; maintains ICT infrastructure and end\-user computing services; and contributes to cybersecurity, service improvement and ICT projects. The role operates within approved governance frameworks, time, quality and budget requirements. Scope of the Role The role is a broad enterprise ICT support and administration position spanning user\-facing support, service desk operations, endpoint services, Microsoft platforms, on\-premises infrastructure, identity and access management, networking, cybersecurity, technical documentation, supplier liaison and project delivery. The postholder is expected to resolve issues at the appropriate support level, escalate effectively, protect service continuity and communicate clearly with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. Main Duties and Responsibilities Frontline User Support, Service Desk and Level 1 Support * Act as a professional first point of contact for ICT incidents, service requests, access requests and user queries received by telephone, portal, email, Teams, walk\-up or other approved channels. * Log, categorise, prioritise, own and progress tickets in the approved service management platform, maintaining clear and timely records throughout the ticket lifecycle. * Provide Level 1 diagnosis and resolution for common hardware, software, account, printing, connectivity, collaboration, telephony, mobile device and peripheral issues. * Support users at our Ireland locations and remote workers through approved remote\-support tools and onsite assistance. * Provide clear user guidance for Microsoft 365 applications, Windows, browsers, business applications and approved mobile services. * Perform password resets, account unlocks, MFA registration support and standard access remediation in accordance with approved identity verification and access procedures. * Prepare, deploy, replace, recover and troubleshoot laptops, desktops, monitors, printers, headsets, mobile devices and associated peripherals. * Maintain ownership of assigned incidents and requests, keep users informed, meet applicable service targets and confirm satisfactory resolution before closure. * Identify recurring incidents, knowledge gaps and training needs, and contribute solutions, knowledge articles and user communications. Level 2 Technical Support and Escalation * Undertake advanced diagnosis and resolution of incidents escalated from Level 1 support or identified through monitoring and operational activity. * Troubleshoot Windows, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Entra ID, endpoint, network, authentication, application and infrastructure issues using appropriate technical and administrative tools. * Analyse logs, alerts, configuration, performance and dependency information to identify root cause or determine the most effective escalation route. * Coordinate with internal technical specialists, system owners, cybersecurity personnel, application teams and external suppliers where third\-line or specialist intervention is required. * Create technically complete escalations that include business impact, troubleshooting performed, evidence, timestamps, affected services and current workaround status. * Contribute to problem management, root cause analysis, known\-error records, post\-incident reviews and permanent corrective actions. * Provide planned out\-of\-hours, on\-call or weekend support where required by operational arrangements. Microsoft 365 Applications and Tenant Administration * Administer and support the Microsoft 365 tenant and associated services in accordance with approved roles, policies and change controls. * Provide administration and Level 1/Level 2 support for Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Microsoft 365 Apps and related services. * Support mailbox, distribution list, shared mailbox, Teams, SharePoint site, OneDrive, permissions, sharing and collaboration issues. * Monitor Microsoft 365 service health and operational alerts, assess user impact and communicate or escalate appropriately. * Assist with tenant configuration, feature deployment, update readiness, licensing allocation, licence optimisation and service adoption. * Support approved governance controls for guest access, external sharing, application consent, retention, information protection and collaboration. * Use PowerShell, Microsoft Graph and approved automation tools to improve administration, reporting and repeatability where appropriate. * Create and maintain tenant configuration records, standard operating procedures, support documentation and evidence required for audit or review. Microsoft Entra ID, Identity and Access Management * Administer users, groups, enterprise applications, service principals and assigned administrative roles in Microsoft Entra ID and hybrid identity services. * Support the joiner, mover and leaver lifecycle, ensuring identity and access changes are authorised, accurate, timely and traceable. * Administer and troubleshoot authentication, single sign\-on, MFA, self\-service password reset, device identity and access issues. * Support implementation, testing and monitoring of Conditional Access policies under approved governance and change control. * Administer user access rights and role assignments associated with RBAC, privileged access and identity governance standards. * Support identity governance activities including access reviews, entitlement reviews, inactive account review and privileged access monitoring. * Monitor identity\-related alerts, risky sign\-ins and suspicious authentication activity, and escalate or respond in accordance with incident procedures. * Maintain emergency access, administrative account and service account controls in accordance with approved standards. Azure and Cloud Platform Support * Provide operational support for Microsoft Azure services within the responsibilities assigned to the ICT function. * Assist with Azure subscription, resource group, access, policy, monitoring, tagging, cost\-awareness and governance activities. * Support Azure\-hosted virtual machines, storage, networking, backup, monitoring and related services where deployed. * Apply approved RBAC, security, logging, backup, resilience and configuration standards to cloud resources. * Participate in cloud migrations, service onboarding, technical assurance and operational handover activities. * Investigate cloud service incidents and coordinate escalation to service owners, suppliers or Microsoft support where required. On\-Premises Infrastructure and Core Services * Administer and support day to day operation of assigned infrastructure including Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, certificate, file, print and related infrastructure services within delegated authority and documented procedures. * Support hybrid integration between on\-premises Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, including identity synchronisation and authentication dependencies. * Perform user, group, computer, shared resource and permissions administration in accordance with approved access controls. * Support server, storage, virtualisation and backup platforms, including monitoring, routine checks, restore requests and incident resolution. * Apply approved security hardening, anti\-malware, encryption, patching and configuration standards to desktop and server platforms. * Support business continuity, disaster recovery, backup validation, technical recovery testing and service restoration activities. * Maintain accurate configuration, asset, warranty, location, ownership and lifecycle records for ICT equipment and systems. Endpoint, Application and Device Management * Build, configure, deploy and support Windows endpoints and approved applications using current enterprise management tools. * Administer endpoint compliance, configuration profiles, software deployment, update management and security controls through Microsoft Intune, KACE or other approved platforms. * Support iPhone, iPad and other approved mobile devices, mobile applications and access controls. * Diagnose application installation, compatibility, performance, licensing and user\-profile issues. * Coordinate application packaging, testing, deployment and rollback activities in accordance with change and release controls. * Support asset discovery, software inventory, licence tracking and device lifecycle processes. title: Ryanair Group International Grad Programme 2027
description: Ryanair, over our 40 year history has grown to become Europe’s largest airline group connecting more guests across more routes than any other European carrier. We are a fast\-paced, ambitious and innovative company, offering exciting career opportunities across aviation, technology, operations and support functions. With offices located in Dublin, Malta, Madrid, Warsaw and across Europe, now is a fantastic time to join as we look to grow to over 800 aircraft and 300m guests within the next 8 years. Looking for a challenging and rewarding Grad Programme? Do you want to work for an industry leader where career progression is a given if you work hard and show dedication? Then join the **2027 Ryanair Group International Grad Programme** These unique programmes provide will give successful candidates the chance to rotate across teams in both our Dublin HQ and also our Malta, Warsaw and Vienna offices allowing you to gain transferable skills and a deep understanding of Ryanair Group, to set you up on a career path to the skies! Across the 2 year programme, our grads will get mentorship from our leadership team, will be part of a structured programme with trips, tips and insights into Europe’s largest airline which will allow you to develop while we grow to be The World’s Largest Airline There are 3 distinct programmes and opportunities, **Malta Air, Lauda Europe and Buzz.** **Malta Air** Headquartered in Malta, Malta Air is part of Ryanair group with a fleet of over 180 B737 aircraft based across some of Ryanair’s key markets such as Italy, Germany, France, Malta, Romania, Denmark, Sweden and more. Our Malta office has a number of functions including Finance, Safety, HR and Flight Operations. Grads will work in Dublin HQ for a period of **6 months** as part of some of the wider teams within the group functions here before relocating to Malta to work in a similar function in Malta Air for the remaining **18 months** of the programme **Lauda Europe** The only A320 operator of Ryanair Group, Lauda operate a fleet of 27 Airbus A320’s based across Vienna, Croatia and Palma. While Lauda is headquartered in Malta, the majority of operations is run from our Vienna office where the primary functions include Operations (including FOPs, GOPs \& Inflight), HR and Finance. The Lauda Grad will spend a min of **6** **Months** in Dublin rotating across these functions before relocating to **Vienna** for the remainder of programme where they will continue to work across these key functions. **BUZZ / Ryanair Sun** Headquarted in Warsaw, Buzz is part of Ryanair group with a fleet of over 90 B737 aircraft based primarily across Central and Eastern Europe. Buzz is a fast growing and unique brand within Ryanair group as they offer both scheduled and charter services. With a brand new training centre recently opened in Krakow and growth plans across the region, Buzz runs a number of key functions such as HR, Finance, Operations (Inflight, GOPs and FOPs), Customer Service and more providing excellent exposure to eager graduates. Grads will work in Dublin HQ for a min of **6 months** as part of some of the wider teams within the group functions here before relocating to Warsaw to work in a similar function **The Application Process** Motivation is key for Ryanair, we want to hear from Grads who have a genuine interest in working here, so please get this across in your application. We ask that you input your preferences as to which programme you’re keen to work in the most, but our Recruiters will review your application and may reach out if they feel you are more suitable for other depts Applications will remain open until **31st January 2027** . We recommend getting your application in earlier as like our aircraft, we like to be on\-time! Everyone we hire needs to show the skills and behaviours that have helped us to achieve our growth over the last 40 years and we expect candidates to demonstrate a hardworking and entrepreneurial spirit during the interview process If we decide to progress your application you will be invited for a phone call (if an Irish number is calling, make sure you answer), followed by an online interview. As part of the process, all grads must come to Dublin for a Face\-to\-Face interview In the questions please state why you want to join the Ryanair Grad Programme and let us know about which areas that you are particularly interested in working in, we get thousands of applications so this is your sales pitch! * Studied a relevant degree programme(Bachelors/Masters) with a secured 2\.1 or above or be on track to * Graduated/finished university no earlier than 2025 * Hold the unrestricted right to live and work in The EU and travel freely throughout Europe. * Strong analytical skills for efficiency, quality and continuous improvements * Ability to work in a pressurised and fast paced environment * Organisational, interpersonal skills and work on own initiative * Excellent communication skills * Fluency in Polish, Spanish, German or Maltese will be highly regarded * Good sense of humour and doesn’t take themselves too seriously * Competitive salary * Unlimited discount travel to over 230 destinations * Defined Contribution Pension Scheme – Matched up to 5% or €5,000 * Death in Service Benefit * 20 Days Annual Leave – Increasing to 22 days after 12 months and 25 days after 3 years * Cycle 2 Work Scheme * Unrivalled career progression *These benefits are applicable when in Dublin only. These will change based on the final work location subject to local law and T\&Cs*

description: At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better.
